title: Linguistic Survey of India: Vol. III, Part I - Tibeto-Burman Family and Northern Assam Borderlands
title_english: Linguistic Survey of India: Vol. III, Part I - Tibeto-Burman Family and Northern Assam Borderlands
title_as: ভাৰতীয় ভাষাতাত্বিক জৰীপ: তৃতীয় খণ্ড, প্ৰথম ভাগ - উত্তৰ অসম সীমান্ত
author: Sir George Abraham Grierson, K.C.I.E.
provenance: Superintendent of Government Printing, Calcutta; Archive ID linguisticsurvey31ling
description: Sir George A. Grierson's master comparative linguistic survey establishing the structural typologies, tonal classifications, and grammatical paradigms connecting the Tai group (Khamti, Nora, Khamyang) with northern Assam borderland languages.
